title: The Singing Skull
text: A skull on a pole by the road, jaw clacking, singing a marching song in a cracked voice. It knows all the verses, and some that are very rude. It says it knows the way, and that it was a soldier once, and that it is very bored.

options.label: Take it along as a guide. A bored soldier still knows the roads.

outcomes.text: It sings you down a better road.
It sings you down a road it likes better.

options.label: The wisest learns its song, every verse, even the rude ones.

outcomes.text: It is a good song, and it sticks, and the march goes easier.

options.label: Smash the skull, and let the soldier rest at last.

outcomes.text: It goes on singing, quieter, from the pieces.
